subject: Money
title: Land Value Tax
description: Learn Land Value Tax in one minute.

hook.text: A parking lot in Manhattan is worth $100 million. The owner pays less tax than a factory employing 500 people.

buildup.text: Henry George proposed taxing land value, not improvements. Tax the location, not the building on it.

discovery.text: Land value is created by community investment—roads, schools, transit—not the owner. Society should capture that value.

twist.text: Singapore uses land value capture extensively. Public land ownership funds world-class infrastructure.

climax.text: Land value tax can't be avoided—you can't move land offshore. It's the one tax that can't be gamed.

punchline.text: Tax the land. It can't leave.

quiz.question: Why can't land value tax be avoided?
options: Land can't be moved offshore or hidden
